game.knot_thread: Press the glowing ring to feed the string through it.
按下发光的圆环，让绳子穿过去。

game.knot_loop: Now press the loose end to loop it over the string.
现在按下松开的绳头，让它绕过绳子打个圈。
이제 풀린 끝을 눌러 끈 위로 고리를 만드세요.
Sekarang tekan hujung yang longgar untuk membuat gelung di atas tali.

game.knot_tighten: Press the loop to pull the knot tight.
लूप को दबाएँ ताकि गाँठ कस जाए।
game.knot_next_end: The block's end is tied. Now do the same at the Newton meter's hook ring.
木块这一端系好了。现在在牛顿测力计的挂环上做同样的事。
